Optionally post one short line, such as “TG Monitor: Telegram is unreachable”, to your own HTTPS address (for example an ntfy.sh topic) when the published status changes. History, diagnostics and tokens are never sent; the same status is posted at most once a minute. Anyone who knows the address can post to it, so it is stored privately, excluded from backups and diagnostics, and used only after the device is unlocked. Off by default.
HTTPS only, up to 512 characters, without a login or #fragment. The saved address is not shown; enter it again to replace it.
Enter a valid https:// address without a login or #fragment.
Set a valid webhook address first.

Adds fresh measured status at most every five minutes per target. No new checks or timers. Heartbeats follow status filters: OK uses Recovery; DOWN uses Unreachable; PARTIAL and No network use their matching filters. Network restored remains an event. Test messages never claim live monitoring.
